panels.title: Probe Success
panels.description: Daily UTC probe success aggregates over the last 30 days; observation success is not a production SLA.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_utc AS time, success_rate_pct AS value, agent_id AS metric FROM v_daily_probe_reliability WHERE $__timeFilter(date_utc) ORDER BY date_utc

panels.title: Live Latency
panels.description: Non-null latency from ingested measurements, plotted by original event time. Replayed events can appear in the selected range. No production SLA or continuous real-time delivery is implied.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time, latency_ms AS value, agent_id || ' / ' || target_id || ' / ' || measurement_type AS metric FROM v_grafana_live_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND latency_ms IS NOT NULL ORDER BY event_time

panels.title: Live Packet Loss
panels.description: Measured packet loss for router_ping and external_ping only. Wi-Fi diagnostics encode connection state, not measured ping loss. Ingested measurements use original event time and may include replayed events. No production SLA or continuous real-time delivery is implied.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time, packet_loss_pct AS value, agent_id || ' / ' || target_id || ' / ' || measurement_type AS metric FROM v_grafana_live_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) AND measurement_type IN ('router_ping', 'external_ping') ORDER BY event_time

panels.title: Live Probe Success
panels.description: Each ingested observation shows success as 100% or failure as 0%, separated by measurement type; this is not an aggregate success rate. Uses original event time and may show replayed events. No production SLA or continuous real-time delivery is implied.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time AS time, CASE WHEN success THEN 100.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS value, agent_id || ' / ' || target_id || ' / ' || measurement_type AS metric FROM v_grafana_live_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time

panels.title: Latest Readings
panels.description: Up to 100 ingested measurements in the selected range, newest original event time first; replayed events retain that time. Wi-Fi packet_loss_pct encodes connection state, not measured ping loss. No production SLA or continuous real-time delivery is implied.

targets.rawSql: SELECT event_time, agent_id, target_id, measurement_type, success, latency_ms, packet_loss_pct, jitter_ms FROM v_grafana_live_measurements WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) ORDER BY event_time DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT * FROM v_sre_agent_status ORDER BY agent_id
SELECT * FROM v_incident_summary ORDER BY start_time DESC
